content: Competitors in the bulk diesel delivery space must therefore navigate a complex array of client needs, tailoring their supply chains and service models to the specific operational rhythms of distinct industries. Among the primary industries served by bulk diesel delivery competitors, the mining sector represents the most significant client segment. Current market data indicates that mining accounts for the highest proportion of the client base, reaching 40.0 percent of the total segments served by bulk diesel delivery competitors. While this event serves more as a forum for future planning rather than an immediate solution to the current fuel challenges faced by these industries, it underscores the necessity for bulk diesel delivery competitors to remain agile [22] . Recommended strategies to navigate these challenges include the stringent monitoring of idle fuel consumption, the optimization of haul roads to reduce transit times and fuel burn, and the leveraging of auxiliary equipment data to create a holistic view of energy expenditure [43] .
